summary: Baileys fork performs undisclosed import-time fetch to author-controlled GitHub raw endpoint
details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that adds an unconditional import-time HTTP GET to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alannzxd/xclient/refs/heads/main/information.json in lib/index.js. The response is parsed as JSON and one string field is printed to the console via chalk; the response bytes are never passed to eval/exec, written to disk, or otherwise executed, and no installer data is transmitted in the request. The endpoint is mutable and controlled by the package author. The other flagged network call in lib/Utils/generics.js belongs to the documented `fetchLatestBaileysVersion` / `fetchLatestWaWebVersion` helpers, which regex-parse a version string from upstream Baileys and web.whatsapp.com sources; those helpers are callable utilities rather than import-time behavior and do not transmit installer data.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
